meta.title: Accounting & Financial Reporting Bucharest | CLAR EXPERT
meta.description: Full-service accounting, payroll, tax filings and financial reporting for companies and individuals. CECCAR member.

hero.label: Accounting expertise & reporting
hero.title: Complete accounting and financial reporting for companies and individuals
hero.lead: We keep your books up to date, handle the relationship with the Romanian tax authority (ANAF) and deliver clear financial reports — from balance sheets to management reporting and group consolidation. You focus on your business, we take care of the numbers.

response.title: Prompt response
response.desc: A dedicated contact for your company

card.title: What you get every month
card.item4: Support from real people, no AI

services.label: Services
services.title: Everything accounting, all in one place
services.intro: Full-service accounting and reporting for micro-enterprises, limited companies and group subsidiaries.

accounting.title: Financial and management accounting
accounting.desc: Complete bookkeeping, document recording, mandatory ledgers and your company's financial position, month by month.

payroll.title: Payroll and HR administration
payroll.desc: Salary calculations, pay slips, employment contracts and addenda, REGES submissions and the D112 declaration.

tax.title: Tax filings and ANAF liaison
tax.desc: Preparation and submission of tax returns (VAT, income tax, D112, D394, etc.) and representation before the tax authority.

reporting.title: Financial reporting
reporting.desc: Balance sheets and financial statements, management reporting and periodic group / parent-company reports in the required formats.

consulting.title: Tax consulting
consulting.desc: Legal tax optimisation, legislative-change impact analysis and support for decisions with financial implications.

incorporation.title: Company incorporation
incorporation.desc: Setting up an SRL, SRL-D or PFA: name reservation, drafting the articles, filing the dossier and start-up consulting.

officeHosting.title: Registered-office hosting
officeHosting.desc: A registered-office hosting agreement for your company, with the documents required by ONRC and ANAF correspondence handling.

onrc.title: Trade-register procedures
onrc.desc: Changes at the Trade Register: business activity, registered office, shareholders, directors, share capital, amendments, suspension or deregistration.

about.label: About us
about.title: Accurate numbers, better decisions
about.body: CLAR EXPERT — CL Accounting Reporting SRL — provides accounting and financial reporting services for entrepreneurs and companies in Romania. We focus on accuracy, meeting deadlines and delivering reports you actually understand — not just compliance.

mission.title: Mission
mission.desc: To simplify the financial side of your business and give you real visibility over your numbers.

values.title: Values
values.desc: Integrity, confidentiality and transparency in everything we report and recommend.

method.title: How we work
method.desc: Documents collected digitally, up-to-date records and a clear monthly report, with a single dedicated contact.

team.title: Team
team.desc: A dedicated accountant for your company, who knows your business and responds directly — not a call centre.

pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.title: How we set the fee for your company
pricing.intro: We don't work with fixed packages. We talk to you, understand your company's needs and, based on those, prepare a custom quote — fair for the actual volume and complexity of your business.

step1.title: Initial conversation
step1.desc: Tell us what your company does, how you work today and what's not working. No long forms — a straightforward conversation.

step2.title: Needs analysis
step2.desc: We look at your document volume, number of employees, VAT status and any group-reporting requirements.

step3.title: Custom quote
step3.desc: You receive a written offer with the services included and the monthly fee, calculated on your company's actual situation.

step4.title: We start working together
step4.desc: We sign the contract, take over the bookkeeping and agree on the document flow and reporting deadlines.

note.title: Why we don't show fixed prices
note.body: Every company has a different document volume, tax regime and reporting requirements. A price displayed on the site would be either too high for some or unrealistic for others. We prefer to talk and give you an accurate figure we can stand behind.

quote.label: Get a quote
quote.title: Receive an estimated fee based on your business
quote.lead: Fill in a few details about your company and we'll get back to you with a personalised offer. No obligations.
quote.perk2: Quote tailored to your actual volume
